source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Check GPU's PCIe device ID, vender ID, speed, and bandwidth via cmd: 
$ lspci -nn
$ lspci -s <PCIe_Bus> -vvv


All PCIe information should match SPEC definition.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: All PCIe information should match SPEC definition.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: Selects the first NVIDIA lspci line and filters LnkSta/LnkCap.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: GPU identity and PCIe link capability/status.

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES; correct read-only capability but first-match GPU selection and truncated link fields lose multi-GPU coverage.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: FULLY AUTOMATABLE / IMPROVED; requires stable BDF/slot identity, all required GPUs, full output and field-level SPEC comparison.
historical_reviews.round_02: YES; identifies agent-direct read-only execution and shell quoting issue.

original_test_intent: Verify each required GPU PCIe function has the project-specified vendor/device identity, link capability and negotiated speed/width on the correct slot or topology path.
original_method: Enumerate the complete PCI inventory with `lspci -nn`, resolve every required GPU to a stable domain:BDF and physical slot/topology identity, retain full `lspci -vvv` data, and compare each required field with the project matrix.
manual_activity: The engineer supplies the GPU/slot expectation matrix and later owns the verdict. No manual test action is inherent; enumeration, extraction and comparison are read-only and automatable.
required_inputs: Expected GPU count and BDF/slot/topology map
Expected vendor/device IDs for every GPU function
Expected LnkCap and allowed LnkSta generation/width per topology state
pciutils version and access to full extended configuration output
safety_requirements: Use read-only PCI inventory only; do not reset, remove, unbind, retrain or write PCI configuration.
Do not select the first NVIDIA line on a multi-GPU system.
Retain full capability/status/error context rather than only four filtered lines.
Record missing/ambiguous mapping as evidence and do not retry with state-changing actions.
agent_execution_scope: Enumerate all PCI functions and map each expected GPU using stable IDs, BDF and physical topology.
Capture full verbose PCIe information for every required function and relevant upstream path.
Build an expected-versus-observed matrix including capability, negotiated state, driver and error evidence.
Report Tool Result and deviations without declaring formal PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Supply/approve the authoritative GPU PCIe matrix and topology allowances.
Resolve any ambiguous slot mapping or intentionally degraded negotiated state.
Review comparison and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: `lspci` is appropriate, but `head -n1` can select the wrong GPU and `head -n4`/grep can hide required identity, capability, status and error fields.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain the source `lspci -nn` and per-BDF `lspci -vvv`; iterate the approved GPU matrix and preserve complete raw output before parsing.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Both source lspci forms and 5/5-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Generate a deterministic GPU-function table keyed by domain:BDF, vendor/device ID and slot/topology, with raw verbose evidence and explicit LnkCap-versus-LnkSta comparison.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: PCIe-attached GPUs represented in Linux PCI configuration space.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record OS, kernel, pciutils, GPU model, driver, firmware, BIOS and topology state.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: pciutils/lspci documentation for the deployed version and authoritative project platform PCIe matrix.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds all-GPU stable mapping, upstream context and unfiltered evidence without replacing lspci.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Removes the first-GPU coverage loss and covers every required function.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Negotiated width/speed may be policy or idle-state dependent; the project matrix must define acceptable observations.

project_override_considerations: A project may set target GPUs and acceptable negotiated values by slot/topology. Missing values delay verdict only; they do not make read-only collection blocked or partial.
expected_evidence: Complete `lspci -nn` inventory and GPU BDF/slot/topology map
Full `lspci -vvv` per required GPU and relevant upstream link
Vendor/device, LnkCap/LnkSta and error/status expected-versus-observed matrix
OS PCIe/AER context and final unchanged inventory
Tool Result and separate engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The item, commands and criterion consistently request GPU PCIe information compared with SPEC. Absent SPEC values are readiness inputs, not contradictory source facts.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Collection can run safely without the final SPEC; formal comparison/verdict waits for the matrix. This is not a permanent block.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Keeps read-only lspci but rejects first-match and truncated evidence.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agrees with FULLY AUTOMATABLE and retains all stable mapping and complete-evidence improvements.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates immediate collection readiness from SPEC-dependent verdict readiness and explicitly requires all-GPU coverage.

review_improvement: Prevents one healthy GPU from masking missing, mis-slotted or degraded peers and preserves the evidence needed to distinguish capability from negotiation.
independent_technical_reasoning: All target discovery, PCIe reads and comparisons are machine-executable and non-destructive. Engineer-supplied expectations affect the verdict, not automation classification.

source_provenance.history: review_round_02_functionality.md exact-code entry and repository exact-code search

no_automatic_retry: On access or mapping failure, preserve the output and request resolution; do not reset/retrain the GPU or PCIe link.
